course_name_original: UE Introduction aux systèmes et réseaux

learning_outcomes.text: Provide a first introduction to operating systems and networks, favoring the user's perspective, but also showing the links with hardware and software architecture concepts.
Highlight the complementary role and interaction of systems and networks.
Strengthen practical knowledge related to shell usage and programming applications in C language.

bibliography: R. Bryant, D. O'Hallaron, Computer Systems: A Programmer's Perspective, Prentice Hall, 2003 (chapters 8, 10, 11, 12)
J.-M. Rifflet, R. Yunès, Unix : programmation et communication, Dunod, 2003 (chapters 11, 13, 14, 15, 18, 19, for details on Unix usage)
J. Kurose, K. Ross, Computer Networking, Addison-Wesley, 2000 (the first chapters, for the introduction to networks)
W. R. Stevens, S. A. Rago, Advanced Programming in the Unix Environment (2nd edition), Addison Wesley, 2005
institution: Institut National Polytechnique De Grenoble — Licence Informatique (UGA)
